Conventions\r\nAspect Convention\r\nIDs UUID v4, always a string in JSON\r\nTimestamps ISO-8601 with timezone. 
Nullable fields are null\r\nDates \"2026-09-09\"\r\nMoney JSON number , two decimals\r\nQuantities JSON number , three 
decimals\r\nEnums Production stages, designations and material categories are UPPERCASE. Roles, drawer states, run 
statuses and\r\nwage types are lowercase\r\nUploads multipart/form-data . Imports use field file plus a order_number 
form field\r\nPagination limit + offset . Paged responses carry both total (matching the filter) and count (rows in 
this page)\r\nEmpty\r\ncollections\r\n[] , never null\r\nSynchronous Every write is synchronous. No 202, no polling, 
no SSE\r\nThree rules worth stating explicitly:\r\n1. Never send a production stage. No endpoint accepts one. It is 
derived from the screen (fixed by the role) or inferred\r\nfrom the piece's history.\r\n2. Derived values are 
server-computed - available , total_cost , amount , every count. Send inputs; render what\r\ncomes back.\r\n3. Batch 
writes partially accept. Read the per-item buckets, not the HTTP status.\r\n4. The error contract\r\n4.1 The 
shape\r\n{ \"detail\": \"No drawer with code 'DRW-9999'.\" }\r\n{ \"detail\": { \"error\": \"sequence_blocked\", 
\"message\": \".\" } }\r\n{ \"detail\": [ { \"loc\": [\"body\", \"needs_lining\"], \"msg\": \".\", \"type\": 
\"value_error\" } ] }\r\nHandle all three.\r\nexport function errorMessage(body) {\r\nconst d = body?.detail;\r\nif 
(typeof d === \"string\") return d;\r\nif (Array.isArray(d)) return d.map(e => e.msg).join(\"; \");\r\nreturn 
d?.message ?? d?.error ?? \"Something went wrong.\";\r\n}\r\nA 500 carries a correlation id - show it to the 
user:\r\n{ \"detail\": \"Internal server error\", \"request_id\": \"3f9a2b71-.\" }\r\n4.2 Status codes\r\nCode Means 
Do\r\n200 / 201 OK\r\n204 No content Password change, client delete\r\n400 Bad upload Not .xlsx , or not a valid zip 
container\r\n401 Unauthenticated Redirect to login\r\n403 Wrong role The message often names who can\r\n404 Not found 
Also: unknown barcode\r\n409 State conflict The interesting family - §4.3\r\n410 Gone Retired barcode, or a removed 
endpoint\r\n413 File too large Show the cap\r\n422 Validation Field-level, or a domain sentence\r\n500 Server error 
Show request_id\r\n4.3 The 409 / 410 catalogue\r\nWhere Meaning Recovery\r\nEdit a RELEASED style/SKU Frozen - 
barcodes printed Drive editability off production_status\r\nDelete a SKU with minted pieces Same\r\nStyle code

\"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"article\": \"A-4471\",\r\n\"code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"thickness\": \"0.7\",\r\n\"season\": 
\"SS27\",\r\n\"unit_price\": 118.00,\r\n\"currency\": \"EUR\",\r\n\"production_status\": 
\"DRAFT\",\r\n\"needs_lining\": null\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\n]\r\nsea_cutoff_date is the last day to make sea freight. 
Missing it means air freight - the single biggest margin\r\nevent in the business. It drives the freight-risk 
alert.\r\n10.7 POST /clients/{client_id}/orders\r\nRoles: DM · MD\r\nRequest\r\n{\r\n\"order_number\":

app/modules/imports/router.py · Roles for every endpoint: DM · MD\r\n11.1 POST /imports/preview\r\nDry-run an 
breakdown workbook. Writes nothing.\r\nRequest: multipart/form-data - field order_number (form) and field file (the

\"article\": \"A-4482\", \"skus\": 2, \"qty\": 40 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\nErrors\r\nCode When\r\n400 Not .xlsx / .xlsm , or not 
a valid zip container (an .xlsx is a zip; anything renamed is rejected before it reaches the\r\nparser)\r\n404 Order

write SKUs into the named order. Idempotent.\r\nRequest: identical to 11.1.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"summary\":

/imports/breakdown/{order_number}/release\r\n? THE MINT\r\nThis is the single most consequential call in the system. 
It creates Piece rows, per-piece barcodes and drawer merges,\r\natomically. It cannot be undone.\r\nThree request 
shapes\r\nA - the contract. Each style carries its own answer:\r\n{\r\n\"styles\": [\r\n{ \"style_id\": 
\"4b5c6d7e-8f90-0112-2334-4556677889900\", \"needs_lining\": true },\r\n{ \"style_id\": 
\"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\", \"needs_lining\": false }\r\n],\r\n\"grow_drawer_pool\": true\r\n}\r\nB - 
broadcast. One human answer covering the list. Still a declaration.\r\n{\r\n\"style_ids\": [\"4b5c6d7e-.\", 
\"7e8f9001-.\"],\r\n\"needs_lining\": true\r\n}\r\nC - deprecated. style_ids without a top-level answer falls back to 
inferring the lining requirement from the style\r\nname. Every style released this way comes back with 
lining_declared: false , and the message names them.\r\nField Type Notes\r\nstyles[] array {style_id, needs_lining} - 
preferred\r\nstyle_ids[] array Deprecated alone; fine with a top-level answer\r\nneeds_lining bool? Broadcast. A 
per-style answer overrides it\r\ngrow_drawer_pool bool Default false . Mints the drawer shortfall in the same 
call\r\nResponse 201\r\n \r\n{\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"released\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_id\": 
\"4b5c6d7e-8f90-0112-2334-4556677889900\",\r\n\"name\": \"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"needs_lining\": 
true,\r\n\"lining_declared\": true,\r\n\"pieces_minted\": 60,\r\n\"barcodes_minted\": 60,\r\n\"drawers_merged\": 
60,\r\n\"released_at\": \"2026-09-09T11:04:22.118000+00:00\",\r\n\"released_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\"\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"rejected\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_id\": \"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\",\r\n\"name\": 
\"CARNABY\",\r\n\"reason\": \"already RELEASED on 2026-09-09T09:02:44Z - release tops up quantity 
only\"\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"minted\": {\r\n\"pieces\": 60,\r\n\"barcodes\": 60,\r\n\"drawers_merged\": 
57,\r\n\"pieces_waiting_for_drawer\": 3\r\n},\r\n\"drawer_pool\": { \"size\": 200, \"free\": 0, \"shortfall\": 3 
},\r\n\"message\": \"Released 1 style, 60 pieces minted. 3 pieces have no drawer - grow the pool or wait for one 
to\r\n}\r\nErrors\r\nCode When\r\n422 A style with no lining answer. The message names every unanswered style and 
explains that the answer cannot be changed\r\nafter release\r\n422 styles and style_ids both sent - two lists with no 
defined precedence\r\n422 Neither sent\r\n422 Any unknown field - the body uses extra=\"forbid\" , so a misplaced 
needs_lining is named rather than silently\r\ndropped\r\n404 Order number unknown\r\nFrontend rules\r\n1. Never 
default the lining radio. null is a real state and the server rejects it.\r\n2. Read minted , not the HTTP status. 
Partial accept: an already-released style lands in rejected ; the rest still release.\r\n3. Surface 
pieces_waiting_for_drawer prominently. Those pieces have barcodes but nowhere to be stored - they\r\ncannot pass the 
merge gate.\r\n4. Warn that release is irreversible before the click.\r\nTHE SPINE\r\n12. Barcode\r\nRouter:

authority\r\n410 A retired card\r\n17.4 POST /drawers/send\r\n? Send one or many drawers - and the pieces in them -

\"a0112233-.\", \"b0223344-.\"] }\r\nThere is no destination to pick. Lining is upstream of the store, so a merged

/drawers/{drawer_id}/receive - DEPRECATED\r\nKept working for one release so a frontend mid-deploy does not

done\r\nin bulk through POST /drawers/send . Move to those two.\r\nPEOPLE\r\n18. Attendance\r\nRouter:

calendar; no scope required. combined cannot be created\r\norder_number /\r\nstyle_code\r\nNot both. On a piece run

Compute\r\nboth.\r\n19.7 GET /wages/runs\r\nRun history, newest computed first.\r\nQuery: run_kind · order_number · 
style_code · date_from · date_to · status · limit (50) · offset\r\nDates overlap-match, so a fortnight straddling the 
month boundary still comes back.\r\nResponse 200 - a list of WageRunSummary (as in 19.6, with lines: [] ).\r\nThe 
recompute workflow this exists for: filter by style_code (or order_number ) plus a date range, read the id\r\noff the 
matching row, then POST recompute.\r\n19.8 GET /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nRe-read a frozen run - payslip detail, no 
recomputation.\r\nResponse 200 - a WageRunDetail : everything in the summary, plus last_recomputed_at / _by , 
last_reopened_at\r\n/ _by , last_reopen_reason , and full lines .\r\n19.9 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/close\r\nFREEZE a 
draft. Roles: DM · MD\r\nIdempotent - closing an already-closed run returns it unchanged, because that is what a 
double-click is.\r\nErrors: 409 - refuses to freeze a run with no lines. Locking a window in which nobody is paid is 
never what was meant.\r\n19.10 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/recompute\r\nDiscard the lines and rebuild them from current 
events and rates, for the same window and scope. Roles: DM · MD -\r\nHR is deliberately excluded.\r\nRequest 
(optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": false }\r\nFree on an OPEN run. On a CLOSED run this 409s and tells you to reopen 
first.\r\nconfirm_closed: true is the one-call escape hatch. It works, it stamps the recompute, and it records no 
reason -\r\nwhich is why the reopen door exists.\r\nResponse 200 - the rebuilt WageRunDetail . The run keeps its id, 
window and scope; recompute_count increments\r\nand the actor is stamped, so a payslip reprinted afterwards is 
identifiably a different document from the one paid\r\nagainst.\r\n19.11 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/reopen\r\n? 
UNFREEZE a CLOSED run. Roles: DM · MD only.\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected from 12.50 
to 13.00 after the client re-quote.\" }\r\nThe reason is mandatory and stored, and belongs on every reissued payslip 
for that period.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": \"70001111-.\",\r\n\"status\": \"open\",\r\n\"reopen_count\": 
1,\r\n\"last_reopened_at\": \"2026-09-20T07:11:03.220000+00:00\",\r\n\"last_reopened_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\",\r\n\"last_reopen_reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected.\"\r\n}\r\nDeliberately a separate call from 
recompute. A manager who must press reopen, type why, then press recompute\r\ncannot rewrite a paid payslip by 
mistyping a run id.\r\n19.12 DELETE /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nDelete a run and its lines outright. Roles: DM · 
MD\r\nRequest (optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": true }\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ \"run_id\": \"70001111-.\", \"deleted\": 
true, \"lines_deleted\": 22, \"was_closed\": false }\r\nThe escape hatch the 409 has always named. create_run commits 
an OPEN run before any line is written, so a\r\ncompute that died halfway left a committed, empty run permanently 
occupying that window and blocking every later\r\nrun over those dates.\r\nRefuses a CLOSED run unless confirm_closed: 
true . A frozen run is the document the cash was counted against. To\r\nCHANGE a frozen run, reopen and recompute - 
that keeps the audit trail. Deleting is for runs that should never have\r\nexisted.\r\n19.13 GET 
/wages/runs/{run_id}/breakdown\r\n? One frozen run folded three ways.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"run_id\": 
\"70001111-.\",\r\n\"total_amount\": 48250.00,\r\n\"total_pieces\": 3860,\r\n\"by_style\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_code\": 
\"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"style_name\": \"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"pieces\": 3860, \"amount\": 48250.00,\r\n\"stages\": [\r\n{ 
\"operation_code\": \"LEATHER_CUTTING\", \"operation_label\": \"Leather cutting\",\r\n\"sequence\": 10, \"pieces\": 
600, \"amount\": 7500.00,\r\n\"employees\": [\r\n{ \"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\", \"name\": \"Ramesh 
Kumar\",\r\n\"pieces\": 240, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"by_stage\": [\r\n{ 
\"operation_code\": \"LEATHER_CUTTING\", \"operation_label\": \"Leather cutting\",\r\n\"sequence\": 10, \"pieces\":

Kumar\",\r\n\"designation\": \"CUTTER\", \"pieces\": 240, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\nAll three folds come off 
the same frozen row set, so the three tabs cannot disagree with each other or with the\r\nrun total - which they will 
if the frontend sums them itself.\r\n19.14 GET /wages/runs/{run_id}/pieces\r\n? Per-piece payroll detail. Query: 
style_code · limit (500) · offset\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"run_id\": \"70001111-.\",\r\n\"total\":

\"LEATHER_CUTTING\",\r\n\"work_date\": \"2026-09-04\",\r\n\"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\",\r\n\"employee_name\": 
\"Ramesh Kumar\",\r\n\"employee_barcode\": \"EMP-000123\",\r\n\"rate\": 12.50,\r\n\"amount\": 12.50,\r\n\"note\":

null,\r\n\"amount\": null,\r\n\"note\": \"the stage was unrated at run time\"\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\nAmounts come from the 
run's FROZEN rate for that (employee, style, stage) cell. Nothing is re-priced, so a rate\r\ncorrected after the run 
closed does not change what this says the run paid.\r\nA row with amount: null carries a note explaining why - a 
monthly worker, or an unrated stage. Deliberately\r\nnot a zero, which would read as work worth nothing.\r\n19.15 GET 
/wages/ledger\r\nEvery computed run, latest computed first.\r\nQuery: order_number · style_code · date_from · date_to 
· status · limit (10) · offset\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"total\": 34,\r\n\"count\": 1,\r\n\"items\":

1,\r\n\"reopen_count\": 1\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\nOrdered by when a run was computed, not by its period - the question the 
ledger answers is \"what did we just run\".\r\nrecompute_count and reopen_count make a rebuilt run visibly different 
from one that has not been touched.\r\nReads the frozen rows only. Nothing here is re-derived.\r\nREADS\r\n20.

event in the\r\nbusiness\r\nalert_count is what a badge should render. Empty lists are a good day, not a missing 
feature.\r\n21.2 The four stage dashboards\r\nEndpoint Query Contains\r\nGET\r\n/dashboard/cutting\r\norder_id ~11

garment\r\nGate Blocks Unblock with\r\nRecipe not confirmed Release POST /styles/{id}/material-spec/confirm\r\nLining 
not declared Release needs_lining on every style in the release body\r\nNo drawer Storage, then the merge gate POST 
/drawers/pool or /allocate-waiting\r\nDrawer not sent LINE_STITCHING POST /drawers/send\r\nNot present today Any 
production log POST /attendance/scan-check-in\r\nThe four production gates\r\n# Gate Scope Failure\r\n1 ROLE Whole 
request 403\r\n2 SKILL Per piece Warning - still logged\r\n3 SEQUENCE Per piece sequence_blocked\r\n4 MERGE 
(LINE_STITCHING only) Per piece merge_blocked\r\nNever send\r\n? a production stage - derived from the screen or the 
history\r\n? screen_context - derived from the role (DM/MD/HR may override)\r\n? a computed total - available, amount, 
any count\r\n? a device timestamp for a punch - the server stamps it\r\nThe three \"the system is asking you\" 
moments\r\nSignal Where Meaning\r\n409 with named lot candidates Cut log \"Several lots match. Which 
one?\"\r\nkit.unresolved[] with AMBIGUOUS Store scan \"Several lots carry this article. Pick one.\"\r\nneeds_lining: 
null Release \"Nobody has answered this. I will not guess.\"\r\nEach is a deliberate refusal to guess. Give each a 
first-class UI affordance - they are where the system's accuracy\r\ncomes from.\r\nThe numbers that flow through 
everything\r\nRELEASE qty_ordered ──? N Piece rows ──? N barcodes ──? N drawer merges\r\nCUT dcm_per_piece × 
piece_count ──? lot.on_hand decremented ONCE\r\nRECIPE qty_per_piece × qty_ordered ──? required ──? short_by\r\nWAGES 
ProductionEvent rows × rate-in-force-that-day ──? wage_line.amount\r\nTwo things that are never true\r\nA retired 
barcode 404s. It 410s. They mean different things.\r\nA partial batch is a failure. 29 logged and 1 blocked is a good 
outcome - read the buckets.\r\nKairoX ERP - Production & Traceability API Reference. Companion document: KairoX
