\"set_at\": \"2026-03-27T14:12:00+00:00\" }\r\n]\r\n}\r\nNewest first. A mid-period rate change prices each day at the 
rate in force that day.\r\n19.5 POST /wages/rates · POST /wages/rates/bulk\r\nSingle-cell and whole-sheet 
saves.\r\nSingle\r\n{ \"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"operation_code\": \"LEATHER_CUTTING\",\r\n\"rate\": 13.00, 
\"effective_from\": \"2026-10-01\" }\r\nBulk - all codes resolved first, then written in one 
transaction:\r\n{\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"effective_from\": \"2026-10-01\",\r\n\"lines\": [\r\n{ 
\"operation_code\": \"LEATHER_CUTTING\", \"rate\": 13.00 },\r\n{ \"operation_code\": \"LINING_CUTTING\", \"rate\": 
6.50 },\r\n{ \"operation_code\": \"FINAL_INSPECTION\",\"rate\": 3.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ \"style_code\": 
\"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"effective_from\": \"2026-10-01\", \"rates_written\": 3 }\r\nPrefer bulk when saving a whole 
sheet.\r\n19.6 POST /wages/runs\r\n? COMPUTE ONE PAYROLL. Side-effecting and non-idempotent.\r\nRequest - a piece 
run\r\n{\r\n\"run_kind\": \"piece\",\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"period_start\": 
\"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": \"2026-09-15\",\r\n\"freeze\": true\r\n}\r\nRequest - a monthly 
run\r\n{\r\n\"run_kind\": \"monthly\",\r\n\"period_start\": \"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": 
\"2026-09-30\",\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"freeze\": false\r\n}\r\nField Notes\r\nrun_kind piece 
(default) - pays PIECE_RATE workers. style_code or order_number is REQUIRED. monthly\r\n- pays salaried staff from the 
calendar; no scope required. combined cannot be created\r\norder_number /\r\nstyle_code\r\nNot both. On a piece run 
they define what is paid; on a monthly run they are a label\r\nfreeze true  CLOSED immediately. false  an OPEN draft 
you can recompute freely\r\nResponse 201\r\n{\r\n\"id\": 
\"70001111-2222-3333-4444-555566667777\",\r\n\"period_start\": \"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": 
\"2026-09-15\",\r\n\"status\": \"closed\",\r\n\"run_kind\": \"piece\",\r\n\"scope_order_number\": 
null,\r\n\"scope_style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"scope_is_label\": false,\r\n\"piece_rate_only\": 
true,\r\n\"monthly_only\": false,\r\n\"total_amount\": 48250.00,\r\n\"total_pieces\": 3860,\r\n\"employee_count\": 
22,\r\n\"unrated_operations\": [\r\n{ \"operation_code\": \"FINAL_INSPECTION\", \"operation_label\": \"Final 
inspection\",\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"pieces\": 40 }\r\n],\r\n\"gap_days\": 0,\r\n\"recomputed\": 
false,\r\n\"recompute_count\": 0,\r\n\"reopen_count\": 0,\r\n\"computed_at\": 
\"2026-09-16T05:02:11.004000+00:00\",\r\n\"lines\": [\r\n{ \"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\", \"employee_name\": 
\"Ramesh Kumar\",\r\n\"designation\": \"CUTTER\", \"wage_type\": \"piece_rate\",\r\n\"pieces\": 240, \"amount\": 
3000.00,\r\n\"detail\": [\r\n{ \"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"operation_code\": 
\"LEATHER_CUTTING\",\r\n\"pieces\": 240, \"rate\": 12.50, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\nRead before 
paying anyone\r\nField Why\r\nunrated_operations These stages paid zero. Non-empty means someone worked for 
nothing\r\ngap_days Days in the window no run covers\r\nscope_is_label true = the order/style is DECORATION. Do not 
print \"CLERMONT payroll\" over a sheet that\r\npaid every salaried person\r\npiece_rate_only /\r\nmonthly_only\r\nSay 
so, rather than let a manager read a one-style run as a full payroll\r\nErrors\r\nCode When\r\n422 A piece run with no 
scope. \"Two dates alone would pay every piece of every order in that window.\"\r\n422 Both order_number and 
style_code\r\n422 run_kind: \"combined\"\r\n409 Overlap. The message names the blocking run and what to do about 
it\r\nA piece run and a monthly run over the same window do NOT conflict. Their populations are disjoint. 
Compute\r\nboth.\r\n19.7 GET /wages/runs\r\nRun history, newest computed first.\r\nQuery: run_kind · order_number · 
style_code · date_from · date_to · status · limit (50) · offset\r\nDates overlap-match, so a fortnight straddling the 
month boundary still comes back.\r\nResponse 200 - a list of WageRunSummary (as in 19.6, with lines: [] ).\r\nThe 
recompute workflow this exists for: filter by style_code (or order_number ) plus a date range, read the id\r\noff the 
matching row, then POST recompute.\r\n19.8 GET /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nRe-read a frozen run - payslip detail, no 
recomputation.\r\nResponse 200 - a WageRunDetail : everything in the summary, plus last_recomputed_at / _by , 
last_reopened_at\r\n/ _by , last_reopen_reason , and full lines .\r\n19.9 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/close\r\nFREEZE a 
draft. Roles: DM · MD\r\nIdempotent - closing an already-closed run returns it unchanged, because that is what a 
double-click is.\r\nErrors: 409 - refuses to freeze a run with no lines. Locking a window in which nobody is paid is 
never what was meant.\r\n19.10 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/recompute\r\nDiscard the lines and rebuild them from current 
events and rates, for the same window and scope. Roles: DM · MD -\r\nHR is deliberately excluded.\r\nRequest 
(optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": false }\r\nFree on an OPEN run. On a CLOSED run this 409s and tells you to reopen 
first.\r\nconfirm_closed: true is the one-call escape hatch. It works, it stamps the recompute, and it records no 
reason -\r\nwhich is why the reopen door exists.\r\nResponse 200 - the rebuilt WageRunDetail . The run keeps its id, 
window and scope; recompute_count increments\r\nand the actor is stamped, so a payslip reprinted afterwards is 
identifiably a different document from the one paid\r\nagainst.\r\n19.11 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/reopen\r\n? 
UNFREEZE a CLOSED run. Roles: DM · MD only.\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected from 12.50 
to 13.00 after the client re-quote.\" }\r\nThe reason is mandatory and stored, and belongs on every reissued payslip 
for that period.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": \"70001111-.\",\r\n\"status\": \"open\",\r\n\"reopen_count\": 
1,\r\n\"last_reopened_at\": \"2026-09-20T07:11:03.220000+00:00\",\r\n\"last_reopened_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\",\r\n\"last_reopen_reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected.\"\r\n}\r\nDeliberately a separate call from 
recompute. A manager who must press reopen, type why, then press recompute\r\ncannot rewrite a paid payslip by 
mistyping a run id.\r\n19.12 DELETE /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nDelete a run and its lines outright. Roles: DM · 
MD\r\nRequest (optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": true }\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ \"run_id\": \"70001111-.\", \"deleted\": 
true, \"lines_deleted\": 22, \"was_closed\": false }\r\nThe escape hatch the 409 has always named. create_run commits 
an OPEN run before any line is written, so a\r\ncompute that died halfway left a committed, empty run permanently 
occupying that window and blocking every later\r\nrun over those dates.\r\nRefuses a CLOSED run unless confirm_closed: 
true . A frozen run is the document the cash was counted against. To\r\nCHANGE a frozen run, reopen and recompute - 
that keeps the audit trail. Deleting is for runs that should never have\r\nexisted.\r\n19.13 GET 
/wages/runs/{run_id}/breakdown\r\n? One frozen run folded three ways.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"run_id\":

600, \"amount\": 7500.00 }\r\n],\r\n\"by_employee\": [\r\n{ \"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\", \"name\": \"Ramesh 
Kumar\",\r\n\"designation\": \"CUTTER\", \"pieces\": 240, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\nAll three folds come off

from one that has not been touched.\r\nReads the frozen rows only. Nothing here is re-derived.\r\nREADS\r\n20.

CLIENT and VIEWER are not admitted -\r\nthese expose worker names and floor data.\r\nEvery dashboard is READ-ONLY. No 
bodies, no writes.\r\n21.1 GET /dashboard/alerts\r\n? THE ALERTS, FOR EVERY MANAGER. Query: today (override for 
freight risk)\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"bottleneck\": {\r\n\"stage\": \"PASTING\",\r\n\"stage_label\": 
\"Pasting\",\r\n\"queued\": 41,\r\n\"throughput_per_day\": 12,\r\n\"backlog_days\": 3.4\r\n},\r\n\"stage_spread\": 
[\r\n{ \"stage\": \"LINE_STITCHING\", \"cut\": 100, \"reached\": 58, \"gap\": 42 },\r\n{ \"stage\": 
\"SHELL_STITCHING\", \"cut\": 100, \"reached\": 34, \"gap\": 66 }\r\n],\r\n\"freight_risk\": [\r\n{\r\n\"order_id\":

most work waiting. Not \"the first unfinished stage\", which is wherever the\r\nline happens to have got to and is not 
actionable\r\nstage_spread Where each downstream stage lags the leather cut. The gap is true WIP in

event in the\r\nbusiness\r\nalert_count is what a badge should render. Empty lists are a good day, not a missing 
feature.\r\n21.2 The four stage dashboards\r\nEndpoint Query Contains\r\nGET\r\n/dashboard/cutting\r\norder_id ~11 
grouped queries: production KPIs, current order, per-cutter\r\nperformance, leather lots, per-order progress, 14-day

RESPONSE. This previously returned both cut stages while joining the leather lot, so lining-cut\r\nevents appeared 
with a blank lot and their quantities counted toward leather totals.\r\nstage must be LEATHER_CUTTING or 
LINING_CUTTING - anything else is a 422, not a silently empty list. Only the cut\r\nstages record consumption; asking 
about any other is a question with no answer.\r\ninclude_unmeasured - lining consumption is optional, so a lining cut 
logged without a quantity is excluded by default.\r\nPass true to see those events with a null quantity rather than 
not at all.\r\nexpected / variance / waste are null - they need a BOM, which is Phase 2.\r\n21.4 Employee

Scan-driven UX - the patterns that matter 22.1 The resolve-first pattern Every workflow starts with a scan of unknown 
type. Call GET /barcode/resolve?code=. and branch on const r = await resolve(code); switch (r.type) { case 
\"EMPLOYEE\":     return setActor(r.employee);        next case \"PIECE\":        return setPiece(r.piece); case 
\"LEATHER_SHEET\": return setSheet(r.sheet);   // one physical hide // case \"DRAWER\":    } type : // 
next_expected_scan tells you what's withdrawn - historical codes only case \"LEATHER_LOT\": case \"LINING_LOT\": case 
\"ACCESSORY_LOT\": return setLot(r.lot); Handle the three outcomes distinctly: Status 404 410 Say \"Unknown barcode.\" 
\"This card was deactivated.\" - never \"invalid\" 200 + is_alias: true Use Works, but \"this is an old label - 
reprint it.\" next_expected_scan to drive the wizard. It is answered for every type, including EMPLOYEE - the first 
scan of every workflow.22.2 The state-then-log pattern scan piece + scan worker │  GET 
/production/piece-state?code=.&employee_barcode=. │ ├── ready_to_log: true    POST /production/log immediately ├── 
ready_to_log: false   render blockers[], offer no Log button └── ready_to_log: null    \"scan the worker's card\"  
(NOT \"blocked\") The read uses the same predicates as the write, so a card the UI opens is a card the log will 
accept. 22.3 Batch accumulation Cut and pipeline screens accumulate scans, then post once. Show a running count, allow 
removal, and offer true before committing a large tray. 22.4 Never poll preview: Nothing in Phase 1 is asynchronous. 
Every write is synchronous and returns its full result. There is no 202, no task id, no SSE. Post and render. (The 
Phase-2 procurement engine does use 202-and-poll and SSE. Do not carry those patterns over.) 23. The error contract 
23.1 The shape FastAPI's detail wrapper, containing either a plain string or a structured object: { \"detail\": \"No 
piece with code 'PC-9999'.\" } { \"detail\": { \"error\": \"stale_revision\", \"current_revision\": 7 } } Handle both. 
function errorMessage(body) { const d = body?.detail; if (typeof d === \"string\") return d; if (Array.isArray(d)) 
return d.map(e => `${e.loc?.join(\".\")}: ${e.msg}`).join(\"; \"); return d?.message ?? d?.error ?? \"Something went 
wrong.\"; } Validation failures from Pydantic come back as an array of {loc, msg, type} . Several of this codebase's 
most useful 422s are Pydantic messages written as full sentences - render them verbatim. Every 500 carries a 
request_id . Show it - support traces the failure by it. 23.2 Status codes Code 200 / 201 204 Means OK No content Do 
Bad upload Password change, client delete Not an .xlsx , or not a valid zip 400Code Means Do 401 Unauthenticated 
Redirect to login 403 Wrong role The message usually names who can 404 Not found Also: unknown barcode 409 State 
conflict See below 410 Gone A retired barcode, or a removed endpoint 413 File too large Show the cap 422 Validation 
Field-level, or a domain sentence 500 Server error Show request_id 23.3 The 409s and 410s worth handling individually 
Situation Meaning UI response Released style edited Frozen - barcodes printed Drive editability off production_status 
Lining stored before it was cut The store holds finished parts, not pending ones \"Log the lining cut first\" 
Ambiguous material lot Several lots match the typed spec Render the named candidates and let them pick Lot retire with 
stock reserved Reservations outstanding Say what is holding it Lot spec collision Two lots a cutter cannot tell apart 
Offer the existing lot Wage run overlap Would pay the same money twice Link to the blocking run Recompute a closed run 
Frozen Offer Reopen (with a reason field) Delete a closed run Destroys a payment record Require explicit confirmation 
Client delete with orders Cascade would take everything Offer deactivate instead 410 on a barcode Retired card / lot / 
piece \"This was deactivated\" 410 on an endpoint Removed deliberately The message names the replacement 23.4 The 422s 
that are really business rules Where Message Release \"N styles have no lining answer. it cannot be changed after 
release\" Piece wage run \"A piece-rate run must name the work it pays for\" Spec confirm no_accessories: true while 
accessory lines exist Consumption \"The pieces in this batch have different consumption in their style specs\" 
Employee create \"password is only accepted when a staff login is created\" Consumption grid \"stage must be one of 
[LEATHER_CUTTING, LINING_CUTTING]\" Render these verbatim. They are written to be read by the operator, and they 
explain the rule as well as the failure.24. Badges, chips and status vocabulary Family Value Colour Note Style

`ready_to_log` is a key boolean for automated screens; `blockers` array should be filtered to exclude `skill`, `role`, 
and `designation` warnings.\n- **Constraint**: The `BarcodeDoorSection` is currently tightly coupled with 
`BarcodeDoorForm`. Logic changes in the section must be reflected in the props passed to the form.\n\n### 5. Files and

damage at all.\r\nreturn_to_stage should be a dropdown of stages the piece has already passed - the API 409s on 
anything else,\r\nand you can populate it from GET /production/piece-state 's completed_stages .\r\nPOST 
/inspections/{id}/approve · /decline\r\nBody {\"note\": \".\"} is optional. Only after approve does the garment 
move.\r\nWhat happens after approval\r\nThe piece re-walks everything the redo invalidated: redo FUSING on a piece 
rejected at LINE_STITCHING and it must\r\nbe fused, pasted and line-stitched again, in order.\r\nThose events come 
back with is_rework: true , so cost is separable.\r\nWhile the rejection is pending, the piece is rejected_blocked in 
the production log - it stops moving until the DM\r\ndecides.\r\nGET /inspections?status=&limit= - the DM's 
queue\r\nGET /inspections/pieces/{piece_code} - one garment's history\r\nGET 
/inspections/responsibility?employee_id=\r\n[{\"employee_id\": \".\", \"employee\": \"FATIMA\", \"stage\": \"FUSING\", 
\"rejections\": 2}]\r\nWORKMANSHIP only. Product damage never appears here.\r\n0.7 NEW: Job work (outsourcing) - 
/jobwork/*\r\nDispatch/receive: DM, MD. Read: all floor roles + HR.\r\nPOST /jobwork/vendors · GET

true}\r\nRegistering the same name twice returns the original, not a 409.\r\nPOST /jobwork/dispatch\r\n//

only pieces that came back. Rejected and short are never paid for, and they are kept apart on purpose: a\r\nmissing 
garment is a loss to chase with the vendor, a bad one is a quality conversation.\r\nGET 
/jobwork?status=&vendor_id=&overdue=true&limit=\r\nScreen design. Two views earn their place: what is out right now 
(group by vendor, show pieces_out and days\r\nelapsed) and what is late ( ?overdue=true ). Put the overdue count 
somewhere permanent - a dispatch nobody\r\nchases is how garments go missing, and that is the whole reason this module 
exists.\r\n0.8 CHANGED: Materials - /materials/*\r\nLeather is now tracked hide by hide\r\nPOST /materials/lots and 
POST /materials/receive accept an optional sheets array. LEATHER only - a 422\r\ncomes back for anything else, because 
a 5,000-button packet is one barcode and a count, not 5,000 labels.\r\n// request addition\r\n{\"category\":

mismatch warns, it does not block - refusing a delivery over two decimetres of measurement slop is how a

HR can now create, edit, adjust,\r\ndelete and receive. HR still cannot approve a PO-mismatch substitution (a costing 
decision) or run payroll.\r\nAccessories only reach their own size\r\nstyle_material_spec lines gained garment_size . 
A line with garment_size: \"L\" reaches only size-L garments; null\r\nmeans every size.\r\nWhen the DM adds an 
accessory whose material size reads as a garment size ( S / M / L / XL / XXL or 38 - 62 ),\r\ngarment_size defaults to 
it automatically - so a zip labelled L matches L garments with no extra data entry. A 60cm zip\r\nor an 18L button is 
correctly not read as a garment size and stays on every size.\r\nDesign note. On the recipe grid, show garment_size as 
its own column separate from size . They look alike and\r\nmean different things: size is the material's size (60cm 
zip), garment_size is which jackets it belongs on.\r\n0.9 CHANGED: Barcode - /barcode/resolve\r\nNew type 
LEATHER_SHEET\r\n{\"code\": \"LS-000003\", \"type\": \"LEATHER_SHEET\", \"active\": true,\r\n\"sheet\": {\"sheet_id\":

.the parent lot: article, colour, on_hand. },\r\n\"next_expected_scan\": \"PIECE\"}\r\nBoth blocks are returned: the

hand.\r\nCall Roles Use\r\nPATCH /production/events/{id}/reassign?\r\nemployee_id=&reason=\r\nmanagers 
+\r\nHR\r\nwrong worker on real work - stock\r\nuntouched\r\nDELETE /production/events/{id}?reason= DM, MD the record 
should not exist - stock\r\nreturned\r\nreason is required on delete and the API 422s without it.\r\nBoth return 409 
if the event falls inside a CLOSED payroll run: that run is the document the cash was counted against\r\nand is never 
recomputed, so the fix there is a payroll adjustment rather than a quiet edit underneath it.\r\nDesign note. Offer 
Reassign prominently and bury Delete. Reassign is the everyday correction; delete erases\r\nevidence and moves stock, 
and should feel like it.\r\n0.11 CHANGED: Imports\r\nPOST /imports/breakdown/{order_number}/release no longer returns 
pieces_waiting_for_drawer , and\r\ngrow_drawer_pool on the release body is ignored. There is no pool to wait for - the

CHANGED: Dashboards\r\nGET /dashboard/store/drawers/{id} and /movement still exist but read frozen history. For live 
state use GET\r\n/store/pieces .\r\nGET /dashboard/direct-manager/pieces/{piece_code} now accepts either code - the 
compact PC-222223 a\r\nscanner returns, or the long N1-BF27P010501-SUEDE_BOMBER-NAVY-S-034 . Previously only the long 
one worked, which is\r\nwhy the Analytics & Alert screen errored.\r\n0.13 NEW: Correcting a person - employee reads 
and attendance CRUD\r\nTwo gaps closed. Both are about the same thing: a record naming the wrong person is not a typo, 
it is a wage going\r\nto the wrong worker.\r\nGET /employees/{employee_id}\r\nThe single-employee read the edit screen 
opens on. Previously the only way to show one worker was to pull the whole\r\nroster and filter it in the 
browser.\r\nSame gate as the roster: every internal role; CLIENT and VIEWER are refused (403) because the row carries 
phone and\r\nemail. HR / DM / MD additionally see monthly_salary - everyone else gets the row without it.\r\nPATCH 
/attendance/{attendance_id} - the re-allocation\r\nThis is the important one, and it is not \"edit a field\".\r\nThe 
real mistake on the floor is not \"nobody was here\". Security scans a card at the gate; the card said MAJID, the 
worker\r\nwho actually did the day's cutting was SALIM. By the time anybody notices, MAJID has twelve cutting events 
against his\r\nname - and the wage for them, because wages are computed from the events, not from the 
attendance.\r\nSo changing employee_id moves that day's production events with it, in the same action, and the 
response says\r\nhow many:\r\n{\r\n\"attendance_id\": \"a1b2c3d4-...\",\r\n\"employee_id\": 
\"e5f60718-...\",\r\n\"work_date\": \"2026-09-18\",\r\n\"check_in_at\": \"2026-09-18T03:32:10Z\",\r\n\"check_out_at\": 
null,\r\n\"is_late\": false, \"is_short\": false, \"is_overtime\": false,\r\n\"production_events_moved\": 
12,\r\n\"message\": \"Re-allocated to the correct worker; 12 production event(s) for 2026-09-18 moved 
with\r\nit.\"\r\n}\r\nField Meaning\r\nemployee_id re-allocation - the day's events move too\r\ncheck_in_at 
/\r\ncheck_out_at\r\ncorrected times; is_late / is_short / is_overtime are recomputed, never left saying the 
old\r\nthing\r\nreason free text, written to the audit row\r\nRoles: SECURITY · HR · MD · DM - every attendance 
operator. A gate operator who mis-scans must be able to fix it\r\nwithout going to find 
somebody.\r\nErrors\r\nCod\r\ne\r\nWhen\r\n40\r\n4\r\nno such attendance record\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe target worker is 
already marked present that day - one punch per worker per day is a database constraint, so this is\r\nsaid plainly 
instead of surfacing as a 500\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe day falls inside a CLOSED payroll run\r\nDELETE 
/attendance/{attendance_id}?reason=\r\nRoles: HR · MD · DM only. SECURITY may correct a punch but not remove one - 
taking somebody off the day's roster\r\ndecides whether they are paid for it.\r\nreason is required and 422s when 
blank.\r\nIt refuses with 409 when the worker has production events that day, and the refusal names the better 
operation:\r\nThis worker has 3 production event(s) on 2026-09-18, so the work was really done - the usual cause is a 
swapped card,\r\nnot an absent worker. Re-allocate the attendance to the right person instead (PATCH this record with 
the correct\r\nemployee_id ); the events move with it.\r\nDeleting instead would leave those events dated to a day the 
worker was never marked present - which the production\r\nlog's own presence gate would have refused to 
create.\r\nDesign note. Build the correction screen around re-allocate, with a worker picker, and put delete behind a 
second\r\nclick. The count of events that will move belongs on the confirm button ( \"Move 12 events to SALIM\" ), 
because\r\nthat number is the size of what the operator is about to do.\r\n0.14 Suggested build order\r\nIf you are 
updating the frontend incrementally, this order keeps the app working at every step:\r\n1. Fix the breakages (§0.2) - 
swap /drawers/* for /store/* , stop reading drawer . One afternoon, and nothing is\r\nbroken afterwards.\r\n2. Render 
blocked[] generically (§0.3) - one component, and every current and future gate explains itself.\r\n3. The store 
screen (§0.5) - a list of garments. Deleting the 200-cell grid removes more code than it adds.\r\n4. The cutting grid 
(§0.4) - the biggest new screen, and the one that saves the most time daily. Build it as a\r\nspreadsheet.\r\n5. 
Reject & rework (§0.6) - the defect form plus the DM's queue.\r\n6. Job work (§0.7) - dispatch, receive, and an 
overdue list.\r\nSteps 1-3 are net deletions. Only 4-6 add screens.\r\n---\r\nTable of Contents\r\nSTART HERE 0. What

/dashboard\r\n2. Authentication\r\nSelf-issued JWT bearer tokens.\r\nPOST /auth/login\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"username\": 
\"9876543210\", \"password\": \"\" }\r\nusername is the phone number - that is the login identifier. The 
endpoint also accepts an OAuth2 form body so\r\nSwagger's Authorize button works.\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"access_token\": \"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.\",\r\n\"token_type\": \"bearer\",\r\n\"role\": 
\"cutting_manager\",\r\n\"name\": \"Suresh Iyer\",\r\n\"user_id\": 
\"b2c3d4e5-f607-1829-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9001\",\r\n\"must_change_password\": false\r\n}\r\nThe token response carries the 
role and name. Use them to pick the landing screen immediately - you do not\r\nneed a second call to /auth/me on 
login.\r\nmust_change_password: true  route to the change-password screen and block everything else.\r\nSend the 
token on every request:\r\nAuthorization: Bearer <access_token>\r\nErrors: 401 bad credentials · 403 inactive 
user.\r\nGET /auth/me\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": \"b2c3d4e5-f607-1829-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9001\",\r\n\"name\": \"Suresh 
Iyer\",\r\n\"phone\": \"9876543210\",\r\n\"email\": null,\r\n\"role\": \"cutting_manager\",\r\n\"is_active\": 
true,\r\n\"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-0718-293a-4b5c-6d7e8f9001a2\",\r\n\"client_id\": null\r\n}\r\nemployee_id 
non-null means this login is also a person on the payroll - they can use /attendance/me . client_id\r\nnon-null means 
an external client login, scoped to their own orders.\r\nPOST /auth/change-password\r\n{ \"current_password\": 
\"\", \"new_password\": \"\" }\r\nResponse 204 - no body. new_password must be at least 8 
characters, and the service additionally refuses a\r\npassword equal to the user's phone number.\r\n3. 
Conventions\r\nAspect Convention\r\nIDs UUID v4, always a string in JSON\r\nTimestamps ISO-8601 with timezone. 
Nullable fields are null\r\nDates \"2026-09-09\"\r\nMoney JSON number , two decimals\r\nQuantities JSON number , three 
decimals\r\nAspect Convention\r\nEnums Production stages, designations and material categories are UPPERCASE. Roles, 
drawer states, run statuses and\r\nwage types are lowercase\r\nUploads multipart/form-data . Imports use field file 
plus a order_number form field\r\nPagination limit + offset . Paged responses carry both total (matching the filter) 
and count (rows in this page)\r\nEmpty\r\ncollections\r\n[] , never null\r\nSynchronous Every write is synchronous. No 
202, no polling, no SSE\r\nThree rules worth stating explicitly:\r\n1. Never send a production stage. No endpoint 
accepts one. It is derived from the screen (fixed by the role) or inferred\r\nfrom the piece's history.\r\n2. Derived 
values are server-computed - available , total_cost , amount , every count. Send inputs; render what\r\ncomes 
back.\r\n3. Batch writes partially accept. Read the per-item buckets, not the HTTP status.\r\n4. The error 
contract\r\n4.1 The shape\r\n{ \"detail\": \"No drawer with code 'DRW-9999'.\" }\r\n{ \"detail\": { \"error\": 
\"sequence_blocked\", \"message\": \".\" } }\r\n{ \"detail\": [ { \"loc\": [\"body\", \"needs_lining\"], \"msg\": 
\".\", \"type\": \"value_error\" } ] }\r\nHandle all three.\r\nexport function errorMessage(body) {\r\nconst d = 
body?.detail;\r\nif (typeof d === \"string\") return d;\r\nif (Array.isArray(d)) return d.map(e => e.msg).join(\"; 
\");\r\nreturn d?.message ?? d?.error ?? \"Something went wrong.\";\r\n}\r\nA 500 carries a correlation id - show it 
to the user:\r\n{ \"detail\": \"Internal server error\", \"request_id\": \"3f9a2b71-.\" }\r\n4.2 Status codes\r\nCode 
Means Do\r\n200 / 201 OK\r\n204 No content Password change, client delete\r\n400 Bad upload Not .xlsx , or not a valid 
zip container\r\n401 Unauthenticated Redirect to login\r\n403 Wrong role The message often names who can\r\nCode Means 
Do\r\n404 Not found Also: unknown barcode\r\n409 State conflict The interesting family - §4.3\r\n410 Gone Retired 
barcode, or a removed endpoint\r\n413 File too large Show the cap\r\n422 Validation Field-level, or a domain 
sentence\r\n500 Server error Show request_id\r\n4.3 The 409 / 410 catalogue\r\nWhere Meaning Recovery\r\nEdit a 
RELEASED style/SKU Frozen - barcodes printed Drive editability off production_status\r\nDelete a SKU with minted 
pieces Same\r\nStyle code collision Unique - a barcode caption resolves\r\nthrough it\r\nPick another\r\nPiece scanned 
into the wrong drawer The merge map is the authority \"This garment belongs in DRW-xxxx\"\r\nAmbiguous material lot 
Several match the spec Render the named candidates\r\nRetire a lot with stock reserved Reservations outstanding Say 
what holds it\r\nLot spec collision on PATCH Two lots a cutter cannot tell apart Offer the existing lot\r\nReceive 
with a PO mismatch Article/colour differ DM/MD send approve_mismatch: true\r\nConfirm a spec that is incomplete 
Unresolved lines Show release_blockers\r\nReplace a spec on a RELEASED style Frozen Use POST /materials/issues\r\nWage 
run overlap Would pay twice Link to the blocking run\r\nRecompute a CLOSED run Frozen Offer Reopen with a 
reason\r\nClose a run with no lines Nobody would be paid\r\nDelete a client with orders Cascade would take everything 
Offer deactivate\r\n410 - a barcode Retired \"This was deactivated\" - never \"invalid\"\r\n410 - /production/cutting

\"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\",\r\n\"name\": \"CARNABY\",\r\n\"article\": \"A-4482\",\r\n\"code\":

/imports/breakdown/skus/{sku_id}\r\nCorrect one DRAFT line - the SKU, its parent style, or both in one 
call.\r\nRequest\r\n{\r\n\"qty_ordered\": 22,\r\n\"color_name\": \"NERO\",\r\n\"color_code\": \"BLK\",\r\n\"size\": 
\"50\",\r\n\"knit_color\": null,\r\n\"nylon_color\": null,\r\n\"style\": {\r\n\"article\": 
\"A-4471-B\",\r\n\"thickness\": \"0.75\",\r\n\"unit_price\": 121.50,\r\n\"needs_lining\": true\r\n}\r\n}\r\nSend 
style: {...} alongside the SKU fields and both move in ONE transaction. Two round trips meant a 200 on\r\nthe SKU and 
a 409 on the style left the screen half-saved with no way to tell which half.\r\nNested style accepts: name · article 
· code · gender · label · thickness · season · customer_ref ·\r\ninternal_ref · unit_price · currency · 
needs_lining\r\nResponse 200 - the updated style block with its SKUs.\r\nErrors\r\nCode When\r\n409 The style is 
RELEASED. \"To make MORE of a released style, raise the quantity on a new upload and release again -\r\nrelease tops 
up\"\r\n409 Style code collision\r\n404 /\r\n422\r\n11.6 PATCH /imports/breakdown/styles/{style_id}\r\nThe style-only 
door - for the style header, which has no SKU to hang off. Same body as the nested style object\r\nabove, same 
DRAFT-only rule, same audit row.\r\n11.7 DELETE /imports/breakdown/skus/{sku_id}\r\nDrop a line the sheet should not 
have had. DRAFT and zero minted pieces only.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ \"sku_id\": \"6d7e8f90-.\", \"deleted\": true 
}\r\n11.8 POST /imports/breakdown/{order_number}/cancel\r\nWithdraw DRAFT styles so they stop appearing on the release 
screen.\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"style_ids\": [\"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\"] }\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ 
\"cancelled\": 1, \"style_ids\": [\"7e8f9001-.\"], \"rejected\": [] }\r\n11.9 POST 
/imports/breakdown/{order_number}/release\r\n? THE MINT\r\nThis is the single most consequential call in the system. 
It creates Piece rows, per-piece barcodes and drawer merges,\r\natomically. It cannot be undone.\r\nThree request 
shapes\r\nA - the contract. Each style carries its own answer:\r\n{\r\n\"styles\": [\r\n{ \"style_id\": 
\"4b5c6d7e-8f90-0112-2334-4556677889900\", \"needs_lining\": true },\r\n{ \"style_id\": 
\"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\", \"needs_lining\": false }\r\n],\r\n\"grow_drawer_pool\": true\r\n}\r\nB - 
broadcast. One human answer covering the list. Still a declaration.\r\n{\r\n\"style_ids\": [\"4b5c6d7e-.\", 
\"7e8f9001-.\"],\r\n\"needs_lining\": true\r\n}\r\nC - deprecated. style_ids without a top-level answer falls back to 
inferring the lining requirement from the style\r\nname. Every style released this way comes back with 
lining_declared: false , and the message names them.\r\nField Type Notes\r\nstyles[] array {style_id, needs_lining} - 
preferred\r\nstyle_ids[] array Deprecated alone; fine with a top-level answer\r\nneeds_lining bool? Broadcast. A 
per-style answer overrides it\r\ngrow_drawer_pool bool Default false . Mints the drawer shortfall in the same 
call\r\nResponse 201\r\n{\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"released\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_id\": 
\"4b5c6d7e-8f90-0112-2334-4556677889900\",\r\n\"name\": \"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"needs_lining\": 
true,\r\n\"lining_declared\": true,\r\n\"pieces_minted\": 60,\r\n\"barcodes_minted\": 60,\r\n\"drawers_merged\": 
60,\r\n\"released_at\": \"2026-09-09T11:04:22.118000+00:00\",\r\n\"released_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\"\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"rejected\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_id\": \"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\",\r\n\"name\": 
\"CARNABY\",\r\n\"reason\": \"already RELEASED on 2026-09-09T09:02:44Z - release tops up quantity 
only\"\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"minted\": {\r\n\"pieces\": 60,\r\n\"barcodes\": 60,\r\n\"drawers_merged\": 
57,\r\n\"pieces_waiting_for_drawer\": 3\r\n},\r\n\"drawer_pool\": { \"size\": 200, \"free\": 0, \"shortfall\": 3 
},\r\n\"message\": \"Released 1 style, 60 pieces minted. 3 pieces have no drawer - grow the pool or wait\r\nfor one to 
free up.\"\r\n}\r\nErrors\r\nCod\r\ne\r\nWhen\r\n422 A style with no lining answer. The message names every unanswered 
style and explains that the answer cannot be changed\r\nafter release\r\n422 styles and style_ids both sent - two 
lists with no defined precedence\r\n422 Neither sent\r\n422 Any unknown field - the body uses extra=\"forbid\" , so a 
misplaced needs_lining is named rather than silently\r\ndropped\r\n404 Order number unknown\r\nFrontend rules\r\n1. 
Never default the lining radio. null is a real state and the server rejects it.\r\n2. Read minted , not the HTTP 
status. Partial accept: an already-released style lands in rejected ; the rest still release.\r\n3. Surface 
pieces_waiting_for_drawer prominently. Those pieces have barcodes but nowhere to be stored - they\r\ncannot pass the 
merge gate.\r\n4. Warn that release is irreversible before the click.\r\n---\r\nTHE SPINE\r\n12. Barcode\r\nRouter:

\"e0001111-2222-3333-4444-555566667777\",\r\n\"is_active\": true,\r\n\"editable_fields\": [\"article\", \"colour\", 
\"thickness\", \"supplier_id\"],\r\n\"required_attributes\": [\"thickness\", \"dcm\"]\r\n}\r\neditable_fields and 
required_attributes let the edit form render without a second call to /materials/spec .\r\n13.5 PATCH 
/materials/lots/{lot_id}\r\nCorrect a lot's IDENTITY. Roles: DM · MD · Cutting · Lining\r\nRequest - send only what 
changes:\r\n{ \"thickness\": \"0.75\", \"supplier_id\": \"e0002222-.\" }\r\nAccepts: article · colour · thickness · 
size · supplier_id\r\ncategory , subtype , uom and on_hand are absent on purpose. Moving LEATHERLINING would leave a 
lot\r\nmeasured in dcm claiming to be metres, and every cut event pointing at it would silently re-denominate. 
Setting\r\non_hand directly would make the stock and the movement history disagree with no record of who changed it - 
use\r\n/adjust .\r\nErrors: 409 - the new spec collides with another lot. Material is one lot per spec, or the picker 
shows two rows a cutter\r\ncannot tell apart.\r\n13.6 PATCH /materials/lots/{lot_id}/adjust\r\nA counted stock 
correction - audited. Roles: DM · MD\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"delta\": -40, \"reason\": \"Physical count 2026-09-09: 40 dcm 
unaccounted after re-measure\" }\r\ndelta is the MOVEMENT, not the new total. +12 adds twelve; -12 removes twelve. 
reason is 3-300 characters and\r\nmandatory - it is the only record of why the count and the system 
disagreed.\r\nResponse 200 - the full LotDetail .\r\nErrors: 409 - would take stock below what is already reserved, or 
below zero.\r\n13.7 DELETE /materials/lots/{lot_id}\r\nRETIRE a lot. Never a hard delete. Roles: DM · MD\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"lot_id\": \"a1338000-0000-0000-0000-000000000338\",\r\n\"is_active\": false,\r\n\"barcode_retired\": 
true,\r\n\"on_hand\": 0.0,\r\n\"history_preserved\": true,\r\n\"message\": \"Lot retired. Cut events and consumption 
history are unchanged; scanning the old label\r\nnow returns 410 Gone.\"\r\n}\r\nPresent it as \"retire\", not 
\"delete\". Cut events point at this lot and are the consumption history the costing and\r\ntraceability screens are 
built on.\r\nErrors: 409 - stock is still reserved for a cut.\r\n13.8 GET /materials/stock\r\nAggregate on-hand / 
reserved / available for a filtered material. Roles: stock readers.\r\nQuery: category · subtype · article · colour · 
thickness · size · required\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"category\": \"LEATHER\", \"subtype\": null,\r\n\"article\": 
\"SHEEP GLASS\", \"colour\": \"BLACK\", \"thickness\": \"0.7\", \"size\": null,\r\n\"uom\": \"dcm\",\r\n\"on_hand\": 
3400.0,\r\n\"reserved\": 1035.0,\r\n\"available\": 2365.0,\r\n\"lot_count\": 1,\r\n\"required\": 
3000.0,\r\n\"short_by\": 635.0,\r\n\"suggested_supplier\": {\r\n\"supplier_id\":

\"+919840012345\",\r\n\"last_rate\": 1.72\r\n}\r\n}\r\navailable is derived - on_hand - reserved - never stored, so 
the two cannot drift. short_by and\r\nsuggested_supplier feed straight into POST /suppliers/orders .\r\n13.9 POST 
/materials/receive\r\nRecord a delivery: approved and rejected separately. Roles: DM · 
MD\r\nRequest\r\n{\r\n\"lot_id\": \"a1338000-0000-0000-0000-000000000338\",\r\n\"supplier_order_id\":

/materials/issues\r\nRecord a material issued to one garment OUTSIDE its spec. Spends stock.\r\nRoles: DM · MD · Store

its\r\ngarments are already being issued against it - so a wrong article is corrected by recording what was 
actually\r\nhanded over, not by rewriting the recipe underneath live pieces.\r\nRequest - barcodes or ids for each of 
the three:\r\n{\r\n\"piece_barcode\": \"PC-004821\",\r\n\"lot_barcode\": \"LOT-000112\",\r\n\"employee_barcode\": 
\"EMP-000123\",\r\n\"qty\": 1,\r\n\"note\": \"Zip #5 substituted for #4 - #4 out of stock\"\r\n}\r\nResponse 
201\r\n{\r\n\"issue_id\": \"b0001111-2222-3333-4444-555566667777\",\r\n\"piece_id\":

the kit\r\nchecklist think a spec line was satisfied.\r\nErrors: 422 - neither a piece nor a lot identifier 
given.\r\n14. Suppliers\r\nRoles: DM · MD for all three.\r\n14.1 POST /suppliers/orders\r\nRaise a manual supplier

manual fallback (card would not scan)\r\nreason Free-text context. No longer mandatory - with no geofence there is 
nothing to excuse\r\nlat / lon Accepted, ignored\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": 
\"f0001111-2222-3333-4444-555566667777\",\r\n\"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-0718-293a-4b5c-6d7e8f9001a2\",\r\n\"name\": 
\"Ramesh Kumar\",\r\n\"work_date\": \"2026-09-09\",\r\n\"check_in_at\":

data for a live shift countdown.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\",\r\n\"checked_in\":

\"2026-09-09T08:14:33.221000+00:00\",\r\n\"is_late\": false,\r\n\"timezone\": \"Asia/Kolkata\"\r\n}\r\nCompute a 
one-time server_now - device_now offset and tick toward shift_end_at . Never trust the device\r\nclock.\r\n18.9 GET 
/attendance/config · PATCH /attendance/config\r\nRead: any authenticated. Write: DM · HR · MD.\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"shift_start\": \"09:00\",\r\n\"shift_length_hours\": 8.0,\r\n\"late_grace_minutes\": 
15,\r\n\"timezone\": \"Asia/Kolkata\"\r\n}\r\nPATCH accepts any subset. Shift policy is a database row, not config - 
HR changes it without a redeploy.\r\nThe geofence fields ( factory_lat , factory_lon , radius_m ) still exist on the 
model but are unused. The\r\nprivileged/public response split is retained in case the fence returns.\r\n18.10 PATCH 
/attendance/{attendance_id}\r\nCorrect a punch - and re-allocate the day's work with it. Roles: SECURITY · HR · MD · 
DM (every attendance\r\noperator).\r\nThe mistake this exists for is not \"nobody was here\". Security scans a card at 
the gate; the card said MAJID, the worker\r\nwho actually did the cutting was SALIM. By the time anybody notices, 
MAJID has a day's events against his name - and\r\nthe wage, because wages are computed from the events, not from the 
attendance.\r\nSo changing employee_id is not editing a field. It is \"this was the wrong person\", and the events 
filed under that name\r\nare just as wrong as the punch. They move in the same action, or the money follows the wrong 
worker no matter how\r\nmany times the attendance is corrected.\r\nRequest - every field 
optional\r\n{\r\n\"employee_id\": \"e5f60718-293a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9001a2b3c4\",\r\n\"reason\": \"card swapped at the 
gate\"\r\n}\r\nField Effect\r\nemployee_id re-allocation - that day's production events move too\r\ncheck_in_at 
corrected arrival; the flags are recomputed\r\ncheck_out_at corrected departure; the flags are recomputed\r\nreason 
free text, written to the ATTENDANCE_CORRECTED audit row\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"attendance_id\": 
\"a1b2c3d4-5e6f-7081-92a3-b4c5d6e7f809\",\r\n\"employee_id\": 
\"e5f60718-293a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9001a2b3c4\",\r\n\"work_date\": \"2026-09-18\",\r\n\"check_in_at\": 
\"2026-09-18T03:32:10Z\",\r\n\"check_out_at\": null,\r\n\"is_late\": false,\r\n\"is_short\": 
false,\r\n\"is_overtime\": false,\r\n\"production_events_moved\": 12,\r\n\"message\": \"Re-allocated to the correct 
worker; 12 production event(s) for 2026-09-18 moved with\r\nit.\"\r\n}\r\nproduction_events_moved is 0 for a pure time 
correction and non-zero only for a re-allocation. Show it - it is the size\r\nof what the operator just did.\r\nThe 
flags are recomputed, never carried forward. A corrected punch still claiming is_short from the old times would\r\nbe 
worse than not correcting it at all.\r\nOnly that day moves. A swapped card is one day's mistake; yesterday's events 
stay where they are.\r\nErrors\r\nCo\r\nde\r\nWhen\r\n40\r\n4\r\nno such attendance record, or the employee to 
re-allocate to does not exist\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe target is already marked present that day. One punch per worker per 
day is a database constraint, so it is refused in\r\nwords rather than surfacing as a 500: \"PADMA is already marked 
present on 2026-09-18.\"\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe day falls inside a CLOSED payroll run - that run is the document the cash 
was counted against and is never recomputed,\r\nso the fix is a payroll adjustment, not a quiet edit underneath 
it\r\n18.11 DELETE /attendance/{attendance_id}?reason=\r\nRemove a punch that should never have been made. Roles: HR · 
MD · DM only.\r\nSECURITY is deliberately absent: an operator who mis-scans should be able to correct it without going 
to find anybody,\r\nbut removing the record decides whether somebody is paid for the day at all, and that stays with 
HR and management.\r\nreason is required and the API 422s when it is blank or whitespace. It is the only thing that 
makes the deletion\r\nreviewable afterwards.\r\nIt refuses when the worker has production events that day - 409 , 
naming the better operation:\r\n{\r\n\"detail\": \"This worker has 3 production event(s) on 2026-09-18, so the work 
was really done - the\r\nusual cause is a swapped card, not an absent worker. Re-allocate the attendance to the right 
person\r\ninstead (PATCH this record with the correct employee_id); the events move with it. If the work\r\ngenuinely 
should not exist, delete those events first.\"\r\n}\r\nDeleting would leave those events dated to a day the worker was 
never marked present - a state the production log's\r\nown presence gate would have refused to create.\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"attendance_id\": \"a1b2c3d4-5e6f-7081-92a3-b4c5d6e7f809\",\r\n\"deleted\": true,\r\n\"message\": 
\"Attendance record removed.\"\r\n}\r\nErrors: 404 not found · 422 no reason · 409 production events that day · 409 
closed payroll run · 403 SECURITY.\r\nDesign note. One screen, two buttons, very different weights. Re-allocate is 
primary with a worker picker and a live\r\ncount on the confirm ( \"Move 12 events to SALIM\" ). Delete sits behind a 
second click with a mandatory reason box\r\n- and when the 409 comes back, offer \"Re-allocate instead\" as the 
action, because that is what the operator actually\r\nmeant.\r\n---\r\nMONEY\r\n19. Wages\r\nRouter: 
app/modules/wages/router.py · Roles: DM · MD · HR for reads; DM · MD only for recompute, reopen, close\r\nand 
delete.\r\nWages are not behind bare get_current_user anywhere. CLIENT is a real role with a real login, and 
per-piece\r\nlabour rates are the factory's cost structure.\r\nRoute order is load-bearing - every static segment is 
declared before /runs/{run_id} .\r\n19.1 GET /wages/orders\r\nThe payroll landing screen. Query: on (coverage date, 
default today) · unpriced_only\r\nResponse 200\r\n[\r\n{\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"client_name\":

\"2026-11-30\"\r\n}\r\n]\r\nstyles_priced / styles is the card's badge. Click through to /wages/styles?order_number=. 
.\r\n19.2 GET /wages/styles\r\nQuery: order_number · client_id · unpriced_only · on\r\nResponse 
200\r\n[\r\n{\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"style_name\": \"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"order_number\":

styles pay zero, silently, unless\r\nsomeone looks.\r\nStyle codes, never style ids.\r\n19.3 GET 
/wages/rate-sheet\r\nQuery: style_code (required) · on (default today)\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"style_code\":

run\r\n{\r\n\"run_kind\": \"piece\",\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"period_start\": 
\"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": \"2026-09-15\",\r\n\"freeze\": true\r\n}\r\nRequest - a monthly 
run\r\n{\r\n\"run_kind\": \"monthly\",\r\n\"period_start\": \"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": 
\"2026-09-30\",\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"freeze\": false\r\n}\r\nField Notes\r\nrun_kind piece 
(default) - pays PIECE_RATE workers. style_code or order_number is REQUIRED. monthly - pays\r\nsalaried staff from the 
calendar; no scope required. combined cannot be created\r\norder_number /\r\nstyle_code\r\nNot both. On a piece run 
they define what is paid; on a monthly run they are a label\r\nfreeze true  CLOSED immediately. false  an OPEN draft 
you can recompute freely\r\nResponse 201\r\n{\r\n\"id\": 
\"70001111-2222-3333-4444-555566667777\",\r\n\"period_start\": \"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": 
\"2026-09-15\",\r\n\"status\": \"closed\",\r\n\"run_kind\": \"piece\",\r\n\"scope_order_number\":

true,\r\n\"monthly_only\": false,\r\n\"total_amount\": 48250.00,\r\n\"total_pieces\": 3860,\r\n\"employee_count\": 
22,\r\n\"unrated_operations\": [\r\n{ \"operation_code\": \"FINAL_INSPECTION\", \"operation_label\": \"Final 
inspection\",\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"pieces\": 40 }\r\n],\r\n\"gap_days\": 0,\r\n\"recomputed\": 
false,\r\n\"recompute_count\": 0,\r\n\"reopen_count\": 0,\r\n\"computed_at\": 
\"2026-09-16T05:02:11.004000+00:00\",\r\n\"lines\": [\r\n{ \"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\", \"employee_name\": 
\"Ramesh Kumar\",\r\n\"designation\": \"CUTTER\", \"wage_type\": \"piece_rate\",\r\n\"pieces\": 240, \"amount\": 
3000.00,\r\n\"detail\": [\r\n{ \"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\", \"operation_code\": 
\"LEATHER_CUTTING\",\r\n\"pieces\": 240, \"rate\": 12.50, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\nRead before 
paying anyone\r\nField Why\r\nunrated_operations These stages paid zero. Non-empty means someone worked for

style_code\r\n422 run_kind: \"combined\"\r\n409 Overlap. The message names the blocking run and what to do about 
it\r\nA piece run and a monthly run over the same window do NOT conflict. Their populations are disjoint. 
Compute\r\nboth.\r\n19.7 GET /wages/runs\r\nRun history, newest computed first.\r\nQuery: run_kind · order_number · 
style_code · date_from · date_to · status · limit (50) · offset\r\nDates overlap-match, so a fortnight straddling the 
month boundary still comes back.\r\nResponse 200 - a list of WageRunSummary (as in 19.6, with lines: [] ).\r\nThe 
recompute workflow this exists for: filter by style_code (or order_number ) plus a date range, read the id\r\noff the 
matching row, then POST recompute.\r\n19.8 GET /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nRe-read a frozen run - payslip detail, no 
recomputation.\r\nResponse 200 - a WageRunDetail : everything in the summary, plus last_recomputed_at / _by , 
last_reopened_at\r\n/ _by , last_reopen_reason , and full lines .\r\n19.9 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/close\r\nFREEZE a 
draft. Roles: DM · MD\r\nIdempotent - closing an already-closed run returns it unchanged, because that is what a 
double-click is.\r\nErrors: 409 - refuses to freeze a run with no lines. Locking a window in which nobody is paid is 
never what was meant.\r\n19.10 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/recompute\r\nDiscard the lines and rebuild them from current 
events and rates, for the same window and scope. Roles: DM · MD -\r\nHR is deliberately excluded.\r\nRequest 
(optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": false }\r\nFree on an OPEN run. On a CLOSED run this 409s and tells you to reopen 
first.\r\nconfirm_closed: true is the one-call escape hatch. It works, it stamps the recompute, and it records no 
reason -\r\nwhich is why the reopen door exists.\r\nResponse 200 - the rebuilt WageRunDetail . The run keeps its id, 
window and scope; recompute_count increments\r\nand the actor is stamped, so a payslip reprinted afterwards is 
identifiably a different document from the one paid\r\nagainst.\r\n19.11 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/reopen\r\n? 
UNFREEZE a CLOSED run. Roles: DM · MD only.\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected from 12.50 
to 13.00 after the client re-quote.\" }\r\nThe reason is mandatory and stored, and belongs on every reissued payslip 
for that period.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": \"70001111-.\",\r\n\"status\": \"open\",\r\n\"reopen_count\": 
1,\r\n\"last_reopened_at\": \"2026-09-20T07:11:03.220000+00:00\",\r\n\"last_reopened_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\",\r\n\"last_reopen_reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected.\"\r\n}\r\nDeliberately a separate call from 
recompute. A manager who must press reopen, type why, then press recompute\r\ncannot rewrite a paid payslip by 
mistyping a run id.\r\n19.12 DELETE /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nDelete a run and its lines outright. Roles: DM · 
MD\r\nRequest (optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": true }\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ \"run_id\": \"70001111-.\", \"deleted\": 
true, \"lines_deleted\": 22, \"was_closed\": false }\r\nThe escape hatch the 409 has always named. create_run commits 
an OPEN run before any line is written, so a\r\ncompute that died halfway left a committed, empty run permanently 
occupying that window and blocking every later\r\nrun over those dates.\r\nRefuses a CLOSED run unless confirm_closed: 
true . A frozen run is the document the cash was counted against. To\r\nCHANGE a frozen run, reopen and recompute - 
that keeps the audit trail. Deleting is for runs that should never have\r\nexisted.\r\n19.13 GET 
/wages/runs/{run_id}/breakdown\r\n? One frozen run folded three ways.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"run_id\":

Kumar\",\r\n\"designation\": \"CUTTER\", \"pieces\": 240, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\nAll three folds come off

from one that has not been touched.\r\nReads the frozen rows only. Nothing here is re-derived.\r\n---\r\nREADS\r\n20. 
Analytics\r\nRouter: app/modules/analytics/router.py · Roles: any authenticated, client-scoped.\r\nA CLIENT login is

margin event in the business\r\nalert_count is what a badge should render. Empty lists are a good day, not a missing

363.0}},\r\n\"sheet_dcm_in_store\": 363.0, \"lot_on_hand\": 363.0,\r\n\"difference\": 0.0, \"reconciled\": true}\r\nA 
mismatch warns, it does not block - refusing a delivery over two decimetres of measurement slop is how a 
store\r\nlearns to stop sheeting.\r\nGET /materials/lots/{id} gained five fields\r\n\"received\": 390.0, // everything 
that EVER arrived  was missing entirely\r\n\"rejected\": 15.0, // supplier quality history\r\n\"deliveries\": 
3,\r\n\"sheets_total\": 12,\r\n\"sheets_by_status\": {\"IN_STOCK\": {\"count\": 10, \"dcm\": 460.0},\r\n\"CONSUMED\": 
{\"count\": 2, \"dcm\": 92.0}}\r\nThis fixes the \"Received shows 0\" bug. It showed 0 because the field did not exist 
- nothing ever summed the\r\nreceipts. received - on_hand = consumed now reconciles exactly, so you can show all three 
on the stock card.\r\nNew reads\r\nEndpoint Returns\r\nGET /materials/lots/{id}/history every delivery of that lot, 
newest first\r\nGET /materials/leather-by-style?style_id= arrived / consumed / available per style, split original vs 
rework\r\nGET /materials/pieces/{piece_id}/consumption what one garment took, hide by hide\r\n// leather-by-style 
row\r\n{\"style_name\": \"CLERMONT\", \"article\": \"SUEDE-A32\", \"colour\": \"NAVY\", \"uom\": 
\"dcm\",\r\n\"arrived\": 1000.0, \"consumed\": 920.0,\r\n\"consumed_original\": 860.0, \"consumed_rework\": 60.0, //  
the honest split\r\n\"on_hand\": 80.0, \"reserved\": 0.0, \"available\": 80.0,\r\n\"pieces\": 2, \"per_piece\": 
460.0}\r\nHR can now write\r\nHR was read-only on stock, which is why a wrong lot got fixed in the database by hand. 
HR can now create, edit, adjust,\r\ndelete and receive. HR still cannot approve a PO-mismatch substitution (a costing 
decision) or run payroll.\r\nAccessories only reach their own size\r\nstyle_material_spec lines gained garment_size . 
A line with garment_size: \"L\" reaches only size-L garments; null\r\nmeans every size.\r\nWhen the DM adds an 
accessory whose material size reads as a garment size ( S / M / L / XL / XXL or 38 - 62 ),\r\ngarment_size defaults to 
it automatically - so a zip labelled L matches L garments with no extra data entry. A 60cm zip\r\nor an 18L button is 
correctly not read as a garment size and stays on every size.\r\nDesign note. On the recipe grid, show garment_size as 
its own column separate from size . They look alike and\r\nmean different things: size is the material's size (60cm 
zip), garment_size is which jackets it belongs on.\r\n0.9 CHANGED: Barcode - /barcode/resolve\r\nNew type 
LEATHER_SHEET\r\n{\"code\": \"LS-000003\", \"type\": \"LEATHER_SHEET\", \"active\": true,\r\n\"sheet\": {\"sheet_id\": 
\".\", \"code\": \"LS-000003\", \"dcm\": 47.0,\r\n\"status\": \"IN_STOCK\", \"cutting_row_id\": null},\r\n\"lot\": { 
.the parent lot: article, colour, on_hand. },\r\n\"next_expected_scan\": \"PIECE\"}\r\nBoth blocks are returned: the 
scan must answer which hide and what article and colour is it, and only the lot knows the\r\nsecond 
half.\r\nnext_expected_scan no longer returns \"DRAWER\"\r\nScanned Next\r\nEMPLOYEE \"PIECE\"\r\nScanned 
Next\r\nLEATHER_LOT / LINING_LOT / ACCESSORY_LOT / LEATHER_SHEET \"PIECE\"\r\nPIECE null - the piece is the end of the 
scan, not the middle\r\nDRAWER (legacy label) null\r\nIf your scan flow has a \"now scan the drawer\" step, delete 
it.\r\n0.10 CHANGED: Production - correcting a record\r\nTwo new endpoints replace editing the database by 
hand.\r\nCall Roles Use\r\nPATCH /production/events/{id}/reassign?\r\nemployee_id=&reason=\r\nmanagers 
+\r\nHR\r\nwrong worker on real work - stock\r\nuntouched\r\nDELETE /production/events/{id}?reason= DM, MD the record 
should not exist - stock\r\nreturned\r\nreason is required on delete and the API 422s without it.\r\nBoth return 409 
if the event falls inside a CLOSED payroll run: that run is the document the cash was counted against\r\nand is never 
recomputed, so the fix there is a payroll adjustment rather than a quiet edit underneath it.\r\nDesign note. Offer 
Reassign prominently and bury Delete. Reassign is the everyday correction; delete erases\r\nevidence and moves stock, 
and should feel like it.\r\n0.11 CHANGED: Imports\r\nPOST /imports/breakdown/{order_number}/release no longer returns 
pieces_waiting_for_drawer , and\r\ngrow_drawer_pool on the release body is ignored. There is no pool to wait for - the 
bottleneck is removed, so the \"N\r\npieces have no drawer\" banner should come out of the upload screen.\r\n0.12 
CHANGED: Dashboards\r\nGET /dashboard/store/drawers/{id} and /movement still exist but read frozen history. For live 
state use GET\r\n/store/pieces .\r\nGET /dashboard/direct-manager/pieces/{piece_code} now accepts either code - the 
compact PC-222223 a\r\nscanner returns, or the long N1-BF27P010501-SUEDE_BOMBER-NAVY-S-034 . Previously only the long 
one worked, which is\r\nwhy the Analytics & Alert screen errored.\r\n0.13 NEW: Correcting a person - employee reads 
and attendance CRUD\r\nTwo gaps closed. Both are about the same thing: a record naming the wrong person is not a typo, 
it is a wage going\r\nto the wrong worker.\r\nGET /employees/{employee_id}\r\nThe single-employee read the edit screen 
opens on. Previously the only way to show one worker was to pull the whole\r\nroster and filter it in the 
browser.\r\nSame gate as the roster: every internal role; CLIENT and VIEWER are refused (403) because the row carries 
phone and\r\nemail. HR / DM / MD additionally see monthly_salary - everyone else gets the row without it.\r\nPATCH 
/attendance/{attendance_id} - the re-allocation\r\nThis is the important one, and it is not \"edit a field\".\r\nThe 
real mistake on the floor is not \"nobody was here\". Security scans a card at the gate; the card said MAJID, the 
worker\r\nwho actually did the day's cutting was SALIM. By the time anybody notices, MAJID has twelve cutting events 
against his\r\nname - and the wage for them, because wages are computed from the events, not from the 
attendance.\r\nSo changing employee_id moves that day's production events with it, in the same action, and the 
response says\r\nhow many:\r\n{\r\n\"attendance_id\": \"a1b2c3d4-...\",\r\n\"employee_id\": 
\"e5f60718-...\",\r\n\"work_date\": \"2026-09-18\",\r\n\"check_in_at\": \"2026-09-18T03:32:10Z\",\r\n\"check_out_at\": 
null,\r\n\"is_late\": false, \"is_short\": false, \"is_overtime\": false,\r\n\"production_events_moved\": 
12,\r\n\"message\": \"Re-allocated to the correct worker; 12 production event(s) for 2026-09-18 moved 
with\r\nit.\"\r\n}\r\nField Meaning\r\nemployee_id re-allocation - the day's events move too\r\ncheck_in_at 
/\r\ncheck_out_at\r\ncorrected times; is_late / is_short / is_overtime are recomputed, never left saying the 
old\r\nthing\r\nreason free text, written to the audit row\r\nRoles: SECURITY · HR · MD · DM - every attendance 
operator. A gate operator who mis-scans must be able to fix it\r\nwithout going to find 
somebody.\r\nErrors\r\nCod\r\ne\r\nWhen\r\n40\r\n4\r\nno such attendance record\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe target worker is 
already marked present that day - one punch per worker per day is a database constraint, so this is\r\nsaid plainly 
instead of surfacing as a 500\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe day falls inside a CLOSED payroll run\r\nDELETE 
/attendance/{attendance_id}?reason=\r\nRoles: HR · MD · DM only. SECURITY may correct a punch but not remove one - 
taking somebody off the day's roster\r\ndecides whether they are paid for it.\r\nreason is required and 422s when 
blank.\r\nIt refuses with 409 when the worker has production events that day, and the refusal names the better 
operation:\r\nThis worker has 3 production event(s) on 2026-09-18, so the work was really done - the usual cause is a 
swapped card,\r\nnot an absent worker. Re-allocate the attendance to the right person instead (PATCH this record with 
the correct\r\nemployee_id ); the events move with it.\r\nDeleting instead would leave those events dated to a day the 
worker was never marked present - which the production\r\nlog's own presence gate would have refused to 
create.\r\nDesign note. Build the correction screen around re-allocate, with a worker picker, and put delete behind a 
second\r\nclick. The count of events that will move belongs on the confirm button ( \"Move 12 events to SALIM\" ), 
because\r\nthat number is the size of what the operator is about to do.\r\n0.14 Suggested build order\r\nIf you are 
updating the frontend incrementally, this order keeps the app working at every step:\r\n1. Fix the breakages (§0.2) - 
swap /drawers/* for /store/* , stop reading drawer . One afternoon, and nothing is\r\nbroken afterwards.\r\n2. Render 
blocked[] generically (§0.3) - one component, and every current and future gate explains itself.\r\n3. The store 
screen (§0.5) - a list of garments. Deleting the 200-cell grid removes more code than it adds.\r\n4. The cutting grid 
(§0.4) - the biggest new screen, and the one that saves the most time daily. Build it as a\r\nspreadsheet.\r\n5. 
Reject & rework (§0.6) - the defect form plus the DM's queue.\r\n6. Job work (§0.7) - dispatch, receive, and an 
overdue list.\r\nSteps 1-3 are net deletions. Only 4-6 add screens.\r\n---\r\nTable of Contents\r\nSTART HERE 0. What

/dashboard\r\n2. Authentication\r\nSelf-issued JWT bearer tokens.\r\nPOST /auth/login\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"username\": 
\"9876543210\", \"password\": \"\" }\r\nusername is the phone number - that is the login identifier. The 
endpoint also accepts an OAuth2 form body so\r\nSwagger's Authorize button works.\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"access_token\": \"eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.\",\r\n\"token_type\": \"bearer\",\r\n\"role\": 
\"cutting_manager\",\r\n\"name\": \"Suresh Iyer\",\r\n\"user_id\": 
\"b2c3d4e5-f607-1829-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9001\",\r\n\"must_change_password\": false\r\n}\r\nThe token response carries the 
role and name. Use them to pick the landing screen immediately - you do not\r\nneed a second call to /auth/me on 
login.\r\nmust_change_password: true  route to the change-password screen and block everything else.\r\nSend the 
token on every request:\r\nAuthorization: Bearer <access_token>\r\nErrors: 401 bad credentials · 403 inactive 
user.\r\nGET /auth/me\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": \"b2c3d4e5-f607-1829-3a4b-5c6d7e8f9001\",\r\n\"name\": \"Suresh 
Iyer\",\r\n\"phone\": \"9876543210\",\r\n\"email\": null,\r\n\"role\": \"cutting_manager\",\r\n\"is_active\": 
true,\r\n\"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-0718-293a-4b5c-6d7e8f9001a2\",\r\n\"client_id\": null\r\n}\r\nemployee_id 
non-null means this login is also a person on the payroll - they can use /attendance/me . client_id\r\nnon-null means 
an external client login, scoped to their own orders.\r\nPOST /auth/change-password\r\n{ \"current_password\": 
\"\", \"new_password\": \"\" }\r\nResponse 204 - no body. new_password must be at least 8 
characters, and the service additionally refuses a\r\npassword equal to the user's phone number.\r\n3. 
Conventions\r\nAspect Convention\r\nIDs UUID v4, always a string in JSON\r\nTimestamps ISO-8601 with timezone. 
Nullable fields are null\r\nDates \"2026-09-09\"\r\nMoney JSON number , two decimals\r\nQuantities JSON number , three 
decimals\r\nAspect Convention\r\nEnums Production stages, designations and material categories are UPPERCASE. Roles, 
drawer states, run statuses and\r\nwage types are lowercase\r\nUploads multipart/form-data . Imports use field file 
plus a order_number form field\r\nPagination limit + offset . Paged responses carry both total (matching the filter) 
and count (rows in this page)\r\nEmpty\r\ncollections\r\n[] , never null\r\nSynchronous Every write is synchronous. No 
202, no polling, no SSE\r\nThree rules worth stating explicitly:\r\n1. Never send a production stage. No endpoint 
accepts one. It is derived from the screen (fixed by the role) or inferred\r\nfrom the piece's history.\r\n2. Derived 
values are server-computed - available , total_cost , amount , every count. Send inputs; render what\r\ncomes 
back.\r\n3. Batch writes partially accept. Read the per-item buckets, not the HTTP status.\r\n4. The error 
contract\r\n4.1 The shape\r\n{ \"detail\": \"No drawer with code 'DRW-9999'.\" }\r\n{ \"detail\": { \"error\": 
\"sequence_blocked\", \"message\": \".\" } }\r\n{ \"detail\": [ { \"loc\": [\"body\", \"needs_lining\"], \"msg\": 
\".\", \"type\": \"value_error\" } ] }\r\nHandle all three.\r\nexport function errorMessage(body) {\r\nconst d = 
body?.detail;\r\nif (typeof d === \"string\") return d;\r\nif (Array.isArray(d)) return d.map(e => e.msg).join(\"; 
\");\r\nreturn d?.message ?? d?.error ?? \"Something went wrong.\";\r\n}\r\nA 500 carries a correlation id - show it 
to the user:\r\n{ \"detail\": \"Internal server error\", \"request_id\": \"3f9a2b71-.\" }\r\n4.2 Status codes\r\nCode 
Means Do\r\n200 / 201 OK\r\n204 No content Password change, client delete\r\n400 Bad upload Not .xlsx , or not a valid 
zip container\r\n401 Unauthenticated Redirect to login\r\n403 Wrong role The message often names who can\r\nCode Means 
Do\r\n404 Not found Also: unknown barcode\r\n409 State conflict The interesting family - §4.3\r\n410 Gone Retired 
barcode, or a removed endpoint\r\n413 File too large Show the cap\r\n422 Validation Field-level, or a domain 
sentence\r\n500 Server error Show request_id\r\n4.3 The 409 / 410 catalogue\r\nWhere Meaning Recovery\r\nEdit a 
RELEASED style/SKU Frozen - barcodes printed Drive editability off production_status\r\nDelete a SKU with minted 
pieces Same\r\nStyle code collision Unique - a barcode caption resolves\r\nthrough it\r\nPick another\r\nPiece scanned 
into the wrong drawer The merge map is the authority \"This garment belongs in DRW-xxxx\"\r\nAmbiguous material lot 
Several match the spec Render the named candidates\r\nRetire a lot with stock reserved Reservations outstanding Say 
what holds it\r\nLot spec collision on PATCH Two lots a cutter cannot tell apart Offer the existing lot\r\nReceive 
with a PO mismatch Article/colour differ DM/MD send approve_mismatch: true\r\nConfirm a spec that is incomplete 
Unresolved lines Show release_blockers\r\nReplace a spec on a RELEASED style Frozen Use POST /materials/issues\r\nWage 
run overlap Would pay twice Link to the blocking run\r\nRecompute a CLOSED run Frozen Offer Reopen with a 
reason\r\nClose a run with no lines Nobody would be paid\r\nDelete a client with orders Cascade would take everything 
Offer deactivate\r\n410 - a barcode Retired \"This was deactivated\" - never \"invalid\"\r\n410 - /production/cutting 
,\r\n/production/scan\r\nRemoved Use POST /production/log\r\n410 - /analytics/overview ,\r\n/alerts/*\r\nRemoved Use

}\r\n]\r\n}\r\nErrors\r\nCod\r\ne\r\nWhen\r\n400 Not .xlsx / .xlsm , or not a valid zip container (an .xlsx is a zip;

\"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\", \"needs_lining\": false }\r\n],\r\n\"grow_drawer_pool\": true\r\n}\r\nB - 
broadcast. One human answer covering the list. Still a declaration.\r\n{\r\n\"style_ids\": [\"4b5c6d7e-.\", 
\"7e8f9001-.\"],\r\n\"needs_lining\": true\r\n}\r\nC - deprecated. style_ids without a top-level answer falls back to 
inferring the lining requirement from the style\r\nname. Every style released this way comes back with 
lining_declared: false , and the message names them.\r\nField Type Notes\r\nstyles[] array {style_id, needs_lining} - 
preferred\r\nstyle_ids[] array Deprecated alone; fine with a top-level answer\r\nneeds_lining bool? Broadcast. A 
per-style answer overrides it\r\ngrow_drawer_pool bool Default false . Mints the drawer shortfall in the same 
call\r\nResponse 201\r\n{\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"released\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_id\": 
\"4b5c6d7e-8f90-0112-2334-4556677889900\",\r\n\"name\": \"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"needs_lining\": 
true,\r\n\"lining_declared\": true,\r\n\"pieces_minted\": 60,\r\n\"barcodes_minted\": 60,\r\n\"drawers_merged\": 
60,\r\n\"released_at\": \"2026-09-09T11:04:22.118000+00:00\",\r\n\"released_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\"\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"rejected\": [\r\n{\r\n\"style_id\": \"7e8f9001-1223-3445-5667-788990011223\",\r\n\"name\": 
\"CARNABY\",\r\n\"reason\": \"already RELEASED on 2026-09-09T09:02:44Z - release tops up quantity 
only\"\r\n}\r\n],\r\n\"minted\": {\r\n\"pieces\": 60,\r\n\"barcodes\": 60,\r\n\"drawers_merged\": 
57,\r\n\"pieces_waiting_for_drawer\": 3\r\n},\r\n\"drawer_pool\": { \"size\": 200, \"free\": 0, \"shortfall\": 3 
},\r\n\"message\": \"Released 1 style, 60 pieces minted. 3 pieces have no drawer - grow the pool or wait\r\nfor one to 
free up.\"\r\n}\r\nErrors\r\nCod\r\ne\r\nWhen\r\n422 A style with no lining answer. The message names every unanswered 
style and explains that the answer cannot be changed\r\nafter release\r\n422 styles and style_ids both sent - two 
lists with no defined precedence\r\n422 Neither sent\r\n422 Any unknown field - the body uses extra=\"forbid\" , so a 
misplaced needs_lining is named rather than silently\r\ndropped\r\n404 Order number unknown\r\nFrontend rules\r\n1. 
Never default the lining radio. null is a real state and the server rejects it.\r\n2. Read minted , not the HTTP 
status. Partial accept: an already-released style lands in rejected ; the rest still release.\r\n3. Surface 
pieces_waiting_for_drawer prominently. Those pieces have barcodes but nowhere to be stored - they\r\ncannot pass the 
merge gate.\r\n4. Warn that release is irreversible before the click.\r\n---\r\nTHE SPINE\r\n12. Barcode\r\nRouter:

one-time server_now - device_now offset and tick toward shift_end_at . Never trust the device\r\nclock.\r\n18.9 GET 
/attendance/config · PATCH /attendance/config\r\nRead: any authenticated. Write: DM · HR · MD.\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"shift_start\": \"09:00\",\r\n\"shift_length_hours\": 8.0,\r\n\"late_grace_minutes\": 
15,\r\n\"timezone\": \"Asia/Kolkata\"\r\n}\r\nPATCH accepts any subset. Shift policy is a database row, not config - 
HR changes it without a redeploy.\r\nThe geofence fields ( factory_lat , factory_lon , radius_m ) still exist on the 
model but are unused. The\r\nprivileged/public response split is retained in case the fence returns.\r\n18.10 PATCH 
/attendance/{attendance_id}\r\nCorrect a punch - and re-allocate the day's work with it. Roles: SECURITY · HR · MD · 
DM (every attendance\r\noperator).\r\nThe mistake this exists for is not \"nobody was here\". Security scans a card at 
the gate; the card said MAJID, the worker\r\nwho actually did the cutting was SALIM. By the time anybody notices, 
MAJID has a day's events against his name - and\r\nthe wage, because wages are computed from the events, not from the 
attendance.\r\nSo changing employee_id is not editing a field. It is \"this was the wrong person\", and the events 
filed under that name\r\nare just as wrong as the punch. They move in the same action, or the money follows the wrong 
worker no matter how\r\nmany times the attendance is corrected.\r\nRequest - every field 
optional\r\n{\r\n\"employee_id\": \"e5f60718-293a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9001a2b3c4\",\r\n\"reason\": \"card swapped at the 
gate\"\r\n}\r\nField Effect\r\nemployee_id re-allocation - that day's production events move too\r\ncheck_in_at 
corrected arrival; the flags are recomputed\r\ncheck_out_at corrected departure; the flags are recomputed\r\nreason 
free text, written to the ATTENDANCE_CORRECTED audit row\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"attendance_id\": 
\"a1b2c3d4-5e6f-7081-92a3-b4c5d6e7f809\",\r\n\"employee_id\": 
\"e5f60718-293a-4b5c-6d7e-8f9001a2b3c4\",\r\n\"work_date\": \"2026-09-18\",\r\n\"check_in_at\": 
\"2026-09-18T03:32:10Z\",\r\n\"check_out_at\": null,\r\n\"is_late\": false,\r\n\"is_short\": 
false,\r\n\"is_overtime\": false,\r\n\"production_events_moved\": 12,\r\n\"message\": \"Re-allocated to the correct 
worker; 12 production event(s) for 2026-09-18 moved with\r\nit.\"\r\n}\r\nproduction_events_moved is 0 for a pure time 
correction and non-zero only for a re-allocation. Show it - it is the size\r\nof what the operator just did.\r\nThe 
flags are recomputed, never carried forward. A corrected punch still claiming is_short from the old times would\r\nbe 
worse than not correcting it at all.\r\nOnly that day moves. A swapped card is one day's mistake; yesterday's events 
stay where they are.\r\nErrors\r\nCo\r\nde\r\nWhen\r\n40\r\n4\r\nno such attendance record, or the employee to 
re-allocate to does not exist\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe target is already marked present that day. One punch per worker per 
day is a database constraint, so it is refused in\r\nwords rather than surfacing as a 500: \"PADMA is already marked 
present on 2026-09-18.\"\r\n40\r\n9\r\nthe day falls inside a CLOSED payroll run - that run is the document the cash 
was counted against and is never recomputed,\r\nso the fix is a payroll adjustment, not a quiet edit underneath 
it\r\n18.11 DELETE /attendance/{attendance_id}?reason=\r\nRemove a punch that should never have been made. Roles: HR · 
MD · DM only.\r\nSECURITY is deliberately absent: an operator who mis-scans should be able to correct it without going 
to find anybody,\r\nbut removing the record decides whether somebody is paid for the day at all, and that stays with 
HR and management.\r\nreason is required and the API 422s when it is blank or whitespace. It is the only thing that 
makes the deletion\r\nreviewable afterwards.\r\nIt refuses when the worker has production events that day - 409 , 
naming the better operation:\r\n{\r\n\"detail\": \"This worker has 3 production event(s) on 2026-09-18, so the work 
was really done - the\r\nusual cause is a swapped card, not an absent worker. Re-allocate the attendance to the right 
person\r\ninstead (PATCH this record with the correct employee_id); the events move with it. If the work\r\ngenuinely 
should not exist, delete those events first.\"\r\n}\r\nDeleting would leave those events dated to a day the worker was 
never marked present - a state the production log's\r\nown presence gate would have refused to create.\r\nResponse 
200\r\n{\r\n\"attendance_id\": \"a1b2c3d4-5e6f-7081-92a3-b4c5d6e7f809\",\r\n\"deleted\": true,\r\n\"message\": 
\"Attendance record removed.\"\r\n}\r\nErrors: 404 not found · 422 no reason · 409 production events that day · 409 
closed payroll run · 403 SECURITY.\r\nDesign note. One screen, two buttons, very different weights. Re-allocate is 
primary with a worker picker and a live\r\ncount on the confirm ( \"Move 12 events to SALIM\" ). Delete sits behind a 
second click with a mandatory reason box\r\n- and when the 409 comes back, offer \"Re-allocate instead\" as the 
action, because that is what the operator actually\r\nmeant.\r\n---\r\nMONEY\r\n19. Wages\r\nRouter: 
app/modules/wages/router.py · Roles: DM · MD · HR for reads; DM · MD only for recompute, reopen, close\r\nand 
delete.\r\nWages are not behind bare get_current_user anywhere. CLIENT is a real role with a real login, and 
per-piece\r\nlabour rates are the factory's cost structure.\r\nRoute order is load-bearing - every static segment is 
declared before /runs/{run_id} .\r\n19.1 GET /wages/orders\r\nThe payroll landing screen. Query: on (coverage date, 
default today) · unpriced_only\r\nResponse 200\r\n[\r\n{\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"client_name\":

\"2026-11-30\"\r\n}\r\n]\r\nstyles_priced / styles is the card's badge. Click through to /wages/styles?order_number=. 
.\r\n19.2 GET /wages/styles\r\nQuery: order_number · client_id · unpriced_only · on\r\nResponse 
200\r\n[\r\n{\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"style_name\": \"CLERMONT\",\r\n\"order_number\":

styles pay zero, silently, unless\r\nsomeone looks.\r\nStyle codes, never style ids.\r\n19.3 GET 
/wages/rate-sheet\r\nQuery: style_code (required) · on (default today)\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"style_code\":

run\r\n{\r\n\"run_kind\": \"piece\",\r\n\"style_code\": \"BOG-CLERMONT\",\r\n\"period_start\": 
\"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": \"2026-09-15\",\r\n\"freeze\": true\r\n}\r\nRequest - a monthly 
run\r\n{\r\n\"run_kind\": \"monthly\",\r\n\"period_start\": \"2026-09-01\",\r\n\"period_end\": 
\"2026-09-30\",\r\n\"order_number\": \"BOG-SS27-001\",\r\n\"freeze\": false\r\n}\r\nField Notes\r\nrun_kind piece 
(default) - pays PIECE_RATE workers. style_code or order_number is REQUIRED. monthly - pays\r\nsalaried staff from the 
calendar; no scope required. combined cannot be created\r\norder_number /\r\nstyle_code\r\nNot both. On a piece run 
they define what is paid; on a monthly run they are a label\r\nfreeze true  CLOSED immediately. false  an OPEN draft 
you can recompute freely\r\nResponse 201\r\n{\r\n\"id\":

false,\r\n\"recompute_count\": 0,\r\n\"reopen_count\": 0,\r\n\"computed_at\": 
\"2026-09-16T05:02:11.004000+00:00\",\r\n\"lines\": [\r\n{ \"employee_id\": \"c3d4e5f6-.\", \"employee_name\":

\"LEATHER_CUTTING\",\r\n\"pieces\": 240, \"rate\": 12.50, \"amount\": 3000.00 }\r\n]\r\n}\r\n]\r\n}\r\nRead before

it\r\nA piece run and a monthly run over the same window do NOT conflict. Their populations are disjoint. 
Compute\r\nboth.\r\n19.7 GET /wages/runs\r\nRun history, newest computed first.\r\nQuery: run_kind · order_number · 
style_code · date_from · date_to · status · limit (50) · offset\r\nDates overlap-match, so a fortnight straddling the 
month boundary still comes back.\r\nResponse 200 - a list of WageRunSummary (as in 19.6, with lines: [] ).\r\nThe 
recompute workflow this exists for: filter by style_code (or order_number ) plus a date range, read the id\r\noff the 
matching row, then POST recompute.\r\n19.8 GET /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nRe-read a frozen run - payslip detail, no 
recomputation.\r\nResponse 200 - a WageRunDetail : everything in the summary, plus last_recomputed_at / _by , 
last_reopened_at\r\n/ _by , last_reopen_reason , and full lines .\r\n19.9 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/close\r\nFREEZE a 
draft. Roles: DM · MD\r\nIdempotent - closing an already-closed run returns it unchanged, because that is what a 
double-click is.\r\nErrors: 409 - refuses to freeze a run with no lines. Locking a window in which nobody is paid is 
never what was meant.\r\n19.10 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/recompute\r\nDiscard the lines and rebuild them from current 
events and rates, for the same window and scope. Roles: DM · MD -\r\nHR is deliberately excluded.\r\nRequest 
(optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": false }\r\nFree on an OPEN run. On a CLOSED run this 409s and tells you to reopen 
first.\r\nconfirm_closed: true is the one-call escape hatch. It works, it stamps the recompute, and it records no 
reason -\r\nwhich is why the reopen door exists.\r\nResponse 200 - the rebuilt WageRunDetail . The run keeps its id, 
window and scope; recompute_count increments\r\nand the actor is stamped, so a payslip reprinted afterwards is 
identifiably a different document from the one paid\r\nagainst.\r\n19.11 POST /wages/runs/{run_id}/reopen\r\n? 
UNFREEZE a CLOSED run. Roles: DM · MD only.\r\nRequest\r\n{ \"reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected from 12.50 
to 13.00 after the client re-quote.\" }\r\nThe reason is mandatory and stored, and belongs on every reissued payslip 
for that period.\r\nResponse 200\r\n{\r\n\"id\": \"70001111-.\",\r\n\"status\": \"open\",\r\n\"reopen_count\": 
1,\r\n\"last_reopened_at\": \"2026-09-20T07:11:03.220000+00:00\",\r\n\"last_reopened_by\": \"Tanveer 
Ahmed\",\r\n\"last_reopen_reason\": \"Cutting rate for Sept corrected.\"\r\n}\r\nDeliberately a separate call from 
recompute. A manager who must press reopen, type why, then press recompute\r\ncannot rewrite a paid payslip by 
mistyping a run id.\r\n19.12 DELETE /wages/runs/{run_id}\r\nDelete a run and its lines outright. Roles: DM · 
MD\r\nRequest (optional)\r\n{ \"confirm_closed\": true }\r\nResponse 200\r\n{ \"run_id\": \"70001111-.\", \"deleted\": 
true, \"lines_deleted\": 22, \"was_closed\": false }\r\nThe escape hatch the 409 has always named. create_run commits 
an OPEN run before any line is written, so a\r\ncompute that died halfway left a committed, empty run permanently 
occupying that window and blocking every later\r\nrun over those dates.\r\nRefuses a CLOSED run unless confirm_closed: 
true . A frozen run is the document the cash was counted against. To\r\nCHANGE a frozen run, reopen and recompute - 
that keeps the audit trail. Deleting is for runs that should never have\r\nexisted.\r\n19.13 GET
